edges.subject: CLN3 disease
edges.quote: Onset of cognitive decline at a mean age of 6.8 years (range 2-13 years, n = 19) paralleled onset of visual deterioration at a mean age of 6.4 years (range 4-9 years, n = 81) as supported by an early decline in IQ scores in classical CLN3 disease.
